flows.name: 🎟️ Booking Confirmed
flows.subject: You're in, {{name}} — Your HBM Spot is Confirmed ✅
flows.body:
Hi {{name}},

Welcome to the fold. You just secured your spot at **{{eventName}}** — and we can't wait to meet you.

📅 **Date:** {{eventDate}}
📍 **Location:** {{location}}

Here's what to expect:
- 8-minute structured conversations with extraordinary strangers
- A warm, curated atmosphere built for real connection
- No awkward mingling — just meaningful exchanges

See you soon,
The HBM Team 🧡

flows.name: 🔥 48h Pre-Event Hype
flows.subject: 48 hours, {{name}}. Are you ready for your HBM moment?
flows.body:
Hi {{name}},

In 48 hours, you'll be sitting across from someone you've never met — and 8 minutes could change everything.

**Quick reminder:**
📅 {{eventDate}}
📍 {{location}}

**Our pro tip for your best HBM:** Come with ONE question you genuinely want to ask a stranger. Not a networking question. A real one.

Most people don't prepare. You're not most people.

See you there 🚀
The HBM Team
flows.subjectB: Tomorrow is HBM day, {{name}} — here's your primer

flows.name: 💛 Post-Event Warmth
flows.subject: Something shifted tonight, {{name}} 🌙
flows.body:
Hi {{name}},

Last night happened. And we hope it was as meaningful for you as it was for us.

You showed up. You were present. You gave a stranger 8 minutes of your full attention — and that's rare. That's {{eventName}} in a nutshell.

Want to stay in the loop for the next one? We'd love to have you back.

With warmth,
The HBM Team 🧡

PS — got 30 seconds? Tell us one thing that surprised you tonight: [Feedback Link]

flows.name: ⚡ 8-Min Journey
flows.subject: Hi {{name}} — your 8-minute journey starts now
flows.body:
Hi {{name}},

You've just taken the first step toward something you can't un-see.

The Human Being Movement exists because the world needs more of this: two people, 8 minutes, zero agenda — and the kind of depth that usually takes years.

Here's your invitation to join our next event:
👉 [Reserve Your Spot]

Spots fill up. The conversations are worth it.

See you on the other side,
The HBM Team

flows.name: 💫 Re-Engagement
flows.subject: {{name}}, we miss you at HBM 👀
flows.body:
Hi {{name}},

It's been a while since we last saw you at an HBM event — and honestly, that feels like a missed opportunity (for everyone, including the stranger who didn't get to meet you).

We're running a new experience soon. Different energy. Same magic.

🗓️ Would love to see your name on the list again.

[Check Out the Next Event]

With love,
The HBM Team

flows.name: 🌟 Community Story
flows.subject: A story from the HBM room — worth reading, {{name}}
flows.body:
Hi {{name}},

Every HBM event creates moments. Some of those moments become stories.

This week, we wanted to share one from our community — a real conversation that started in 8 minutes and turned into something neither person expected.

[Read the Story →]

This is why we do what we do. And why we'd love to see you at the next one.

Always,
The HBM Team ✨
